requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid ordinary passport, be in good physical and mental health, have good conduct and comply with Chinese laws and Tianjin University rules.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants who previously held Chinese citizenship or have a Chinese-citizen parent
requirements.ruleText: Meet Ministry of Education Document No. 12 (2020) and submit the published naturalization, renunciation and recent entry/exit evidence where applicable.
Submit a passport copy whose validity extends beyond September 1, 2027.
Submit an uninterrupted study and work experience resume beginning with senior high school and fully disclose prior study in China.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form covering all listed items and completed after September 30, 2026.
Submit a certificate of non-criminal record valid within six months before the application date; qualifying fresh graduates may submit the published school conduct certificate.
Submit the current visa and a good-conduct/performance certificate from the present institution; undergraduate applicants studying at a Chinese university must also submit the withdrawal certificate.

requirements.appliesTo: Documents not issued in Chinese or English
requirements.ruleText: Submit the original document together with a notarized Chinese or English translation.
Tianjin University may request original or notarized hard copies for further qualification checks; false materials result in disqualification.

Complete the TJU online application by May 31, 2027. Scholarship applicants should follow any earlier route-specific deadline; undergraduate scholarship applicants are requested to apply by April 1, 2027.
Pay the published CNY 500 application fee after admission; Chinese Government Scholarship winners are exempt under the stated rule.
Pay CNY 800 per year for accidental-injury and hospitalization insurance.
Budget the published CNY 15-60 per bed per day, depending on campus and room type.
Use the ordinary passport, Admission Notice, JW201/JW202 and original physical-examination records to obtain an X1 visa and register on the dates in the Admission Notice.
Hold a master's degree and be younger than 40.
Submit HSK Level 5 with a score of at least 180; native Chinese speakers and applicants completing the preceding degree in Chinese may use the published exemption.
Submit bachelor's and master's diplomas or the applicable pre-graduation certificate and notarized transcripts; provide final originals before registration.
Submit a Chinese- or English-language research proposal of at least 1,000 words bearing a Tianjin University professor's signature.
Submit two Chinese- or English-language recommendation letters from professors or associate professors.

requirements.ruleText: Upload the Tianjin University supervisor acceptance letter; doctoral research proposals still require the published TJU professor signature.

requirements.ruleText: Submit the published electronic works collection and video presentation.

requirements.ruleText: Submit a bank deposit certificate or financial guarantor income certificate.
Pay the official tuition schedule: RMB 38,000/year.
